description.en:
GR-1 is Fourier's first-generation general-purpose humanoid platform for robotics development and embodied-intelligence research. Its articulated head, torso, arms, hands and legs provide up to 44 degrees of freedom, depending on configuration. Depth cameras and an inertial sensor support perception and motion control.

Fourier's documentation describes a robot approximately 1.65 metres tall and 52 kg, with a three-axis waist and six actuators in each leg. The platform supports work on walking, balance and manipulation, with a listed per-hand load of about 3 kg. Hardware, battery runtime and joint configuration should be interpreted according to the specific GR-1 edition.
